### Item 1 — what the user expresses and how the simulator behaves

- Target object: "the landlord policy on your Barberton rental", "871 Wooster Rd in Barberton"; action: "renew the landlord policy … and pay the full year now"; timing: policy "runs out on November 1"; payment by card, the customer runs the payment himself ("When they hand you the payment step, you pay that full amount yourself for the term starting November 1, and you pay by card").
- Authorisation: identity by phone 513-448-2071 and DOB 1968-03-14 (find_customers returns customer 0163d641-…; verify_customer_identity: "Identity confirmed … (2 detail(s) matched)").
- Passive conditional lines: vacancy is disclosed only if asked ("You say nothing about the state of the house unless the representative asks whether anyone lives there now"); he approves the added charge ("tell them to go ahead and add it starting today"); he declines paying that charge now ("just the renewal today and that the rest can be billed the usual way"). The simulator never directs a next step on its own.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now. Visible grounds:
- Policy record: `LG3-4172-8830`, "LandlordGuard DP-3 Special Plus", status in_force, effective 2025-11-01, expiration 2026-11-01, term_premium 2184.0, indicated_renewal_premium '' (empty), billing_plan quarterly, premium_balance 0.0.
- Offer timing: renewal_indication_record doc: "A LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal that has reached the tier's renewal offer lead time before expiration without an indicated renewal premium on the policy is offered on the day it is found, and the offer date is that day." Lead time 45 days (renewal_and_claims_frequency_values: "Renewal offer lead time … 45" for DP-3 Special Plus) -> 2026-09-17 reached; offer date = 2026-09-22 (today).
- Nothing else stands in the way: every billed installment 2-4 of term 2025-11-01 carries an installment fee; the returned payment of 2025-11-06 has its fee entry; balance 0.00; no inspections, no requests; no nonrenewal ground (1 paid claim in lookback vs DP-3 Special Plus threshold 3; roof 2011; annual lease); vacancy 75 days < 120-day cancellation period.

### Item 4 — scored parameters (formula in words, inputs, tiers, value)

**(a) Vacancy permit** (vacancy_permit_charge doc, baseline): permit "starts on the date of the request and runs through the day before the policy's expiration date, or for the tier's longest vacancy permit if that is shorter" -> 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-31, 40 permit days (DP-3 Special Plus longest permit 120). Charge = term premium × permit rate percentage / 100 × charged permit days / calendar days in term, rounded once.
- Tier results (factor documents found from the records):
  - building-age points (older_building_vacancy_points): year_built '1954' -> 872 whole months from 1954-01-01 to 2026-09-22, band "841 to 1200" -> +5.
  - vacancy-loss points (vacancy_loss_history_points): claims for freeze/vandalism/glass breakage with loss date in 36 months up to 2026-09-22: freeze LGC-25-417306 (2025-01-18) yes, vandalism LGC-23-409815 (2023-02-10) no -> exactly 1 -> +4.
  - prior-permit points (vacancy_permit_repeat_surcharge): additional-premium entries with change_reason vacancy_permit posted in 36 months: 2024-03-05 yes, 2023-05-10 no -> exactly 1 -> +5.
  - tenure credit (vacancy_permit_tenure_credit): original_effective_date 2019-11-01 -> 82 whole months to 2026-09-22 -> "36 to 83" -> −2.
  - charged days (vacancy_permit_charged_days): vacancy_start_date 2026-07-10 -> 75 days vacant on 2026-09-22 (day 1 = 07-10) -> "more than … 60 days" -> 30-day blocks -> 40 rounds up to 60.
- Rate = 20 (tier) + 5 + 4 + 5 − 2 = 32. Charge = 2184.00 × 32/100 × 60/365 = 114.8843… -> **114.88**; permit_start 2026-09-22, permit_expiration 2026-10-31.

**(b) Indicated renewal premium** (indicated_renewal_premium, baseline): expiring premium × (100 + inflation guard)/100 × (100 + rating percentage)/100, rounded once. Inflation guard DP-3 Special Plus = 4.
- claims load (renewal_claims_load): claims with loss date in 36 months up to offer date 2026-09-22: 1 (freeze 2025-01-18) -> 10.
- cause-of-loss weighting (claims_load_cause_of_loss_weighting): latest-loss claim is freeze -> ×1.5 -> 15.
- roof-age load (renewal_roof_age_load): roof_install_year '2011' -> 190 whole months to 2026-11-01 -> "181 to 240" -> +6.
- vacancy load (renewal_vacancy_load): on file as vacant; after the permit, the permit 2026-09-22..2026-10-31 covers the offer date -> 8 × days 2026-07-10..2026-10-31 inclusive (114) / 365 = 2.49863…%.
- household account credit (household_account_renewal_credit): HomeGuard in force yes; umbrella in force with 1 scheduling entry for LG3-4172-8830 and 0 removal/lapse -> scheduled yes -> −7.
- Rating % = 15 + 6 + 2.4986301… − 7 = 16.4986301…; indicated = 2184 × 1.04 × 1.164986301… = 2646.1033 -> **2646.10**.

**(c) Renewal term premium / payment amount** (renewal_term_premium, baseline): min(indicated, expiring × (100 + cap)/100 rounded) × (100 + account adjustment)/100 − flat credit, rounded.
- loyalty cap (loyalty_renewal_cap_4f2bd1bc): 84 whole months from 2019-11-01 to 2026-11-01 (≥ 60) and exactly 1 claim with loss date in 36 months up to today -> 15 − 2 = 13 -> capped 2184 × 1.13 = 2467.92.
- smaller figure = min(2646.10, 2467.92) = 2467.92.
- flood companion credit (flood_companion_credit): FloodGuard in force at the same address; flood claim payments in 36 months up to today: none (only 2021-10-05) -> −3.
- payment-history window (payment_history_window): returned payments in 24 months: 1 (2025-11-06) -> window 24 months.
- late-payment surcharge (renewal_late_payment_surcharge): late fees posted in the 24-month window: 2024-11-15, 2026-02-13 -> 2 -> +4.
- rental book credit (rental_book_credit): umbrella rental_units 2 -> "2 or 3" -> 2 inside the percentage -> −2; no flat credit.
- Account adjustment = 4 − 3 − 2 = −1. Renewal term premium = 2467.92 × 0.99 = 2443.2408 -> **2443.24**; term_effective_date 2026-11-01; payment_method card.

**Fall-back answers (computation documents alone, no factor):** permit charge 2184 × 20/100 × 40/365 = 47.87; indicated 2184 × 1.04 = 2271.36; renewal term premium min(2271.36, 2184 × 1.15 = 2511.60) = 2271.36. All definite and all different from the answers above.

**Factor findability record:** each factor doc was reached from record words: "year_built" (building age), claim "peril: freeze/vandalism" + "loss_date" (vacancy-loss points, claims load, cause-of-loss weighting, loyalty cap), billing "change_reason: vacancy_permit" additional premium (repeat-permit points), "original_effective_date" (tenure credit, loyalty cap), "vacancy_start_date" (charged days, vacancy load), "roof_install_year" (roof-age load), HomeGuard in_force + umbrella underlying "underlying_policy_number LG3-4172-8830" (household credit), FloodGuard "property_address" + flood claim payment (flood credit), "dwelling_payment_returned" (window), "fee_code late_fee" (surcharge), umbrella "rental_units" (rental book). The factor documents name the other products by their official names (HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy, FloodGuard Private Flood Policy). None of the three computation documents said a variation exists; each states "The standard … is …" defaults only.

### Item 5 — executable tool sequence

1. find_customers(phone) -> verify_customer_identity(customer_id, phone, DOB) [agent].
2. find_dwelling_policies / billing / claims; find_home_policies; find_umbrella_policies / underlying; find_flood_policies / claims [agent, read].
3. Ask whether the house is occupied (vacancy_start_date is already on file; asking also elicits the permit consent). Explain the permit and its charge 114.88; customer consents, start today.
4. unlock_agent_discoverable_tool + call `issue_vacancy_permit_2309bb3c`(policy, 2026-09-22, 2026-10-31, 114.88) [agent]. Trial receipt: "Vacancy permit issued: … permit 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-31, charge 114.88 USD posted 2026-09-22."
5. unlock + call `record_renewal_indication_d716047a`(policy, 2646.10) [agent]. Trial receipt: "Renewal indication recorded … 2646.10 USD."
6. Quote 2443.24; unlock_user_discoverable_tool `pay_renewal_premium_4100e9a3` and hand over; customer calls it (policy id, 2026-11-01, 2443.24, card) [user]. Trial receipt: "Payment received: entry drp_…, confirmation …, 2443.24 USD by card for the term starting 2026-11-01".
- Terminal state: permit dates on the policy, one vacancy-permit additional premium 114.88 on the account (left to regular billing per the customer), indicated_renewal_premium 2646.10, one insured payment 2443.24 against term 2026-11-01. Backward dependency: 6 needs 5 (fixed amount), 5 needs 4 (recording condition); the vacancy load in 5 also reads the permit written in 4.

### Item 6 — problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Problems: P1 pay the renewal term in full (customer's own write, root); P2 record the indicated renewal premium; P3 issue a vacancy permit. Direction P3 -> P2 -> P1. Handling order P3, P2, P1.

- Hop P1 <- P2 — **state-derived.** renewal_premium_payment_in_full: "The renewal term premium is fixed only once the policy record carries the indicated renewal premium for the upcoming term." / "while the policy record carries no indicated renewal premium for the upcoming term, the renewal term premium is not yet fixed, and there is no fixed amount for a payment in full." Record: `'indicated_renewal_premium': ''`. Searching "indicated renewal premium" leads to renewal_indication_record: "When the renewal is offered, the indicated renewal premium for the upcoming twelve-month term is recorded on the policy record" and its tool "writes the premium indicated for the upcoming twelve-month term onto the policy record". The pay doc names no other tool.
- Hop P2 <- P3 — **state-derived.** renewal_indication_record: "For a building on file as vacant longer than the tier's vacancy exclusion period, the indicated renewal premium is recorded only after the policy carries a vacancy permit whose dates cover the offer date." Record: occupancy 'vacant', vacancy_start_date '2026-07-10' (75 days on 2026-09-22 > 60, vacancy_values_by_tier "Vacancy exclusion period … 60"), vacancy_permit_start '' / vacancy_permit_expiration ''. Searching "vacancy permit" + "policy carries" leads to vacancy_permit_issue: "A permit issued on the policy carries its first and last day on the policy record" and occupancy_and_vacancy_conditions (eligibility: tier other than DP-1, ≤ longest permit, not retroactive). No tool of another problem is named in the indication doc.
- No hop is pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, aggregates the chain, or sets out a route.

**Counter-proofs.**
- "Do only what was asked" (pay now at some amount): excluded by "there is no fixed amount for a payment in full" while the record carries no indication; recording the indication without the permit is excluded by "no indicated renewal premium is recorded" while the record shows the building vacant > 60 days with no covering permit.
- Closest alternative amount — pay the indicated premium (2646.10) instead of the renewal term premium: excluded by renewal_term_premium ("the smaller of the indicated renewal premium … and the expiring term premium increased by the renewal cap percentage").
- Alternative: include the permit charge in the payment: the persona declines; the pay tool records "the whole renewal term premium … against the upcoming term", so the permit charge is not part of that amount.
- Alternative vacancy-load branch (full 8 %) if the indication were computed before the permit: excluded by the recording condition (indication cannot be recorded before the permit), after which the covering-permit branch applies.
- Permit start alternative (backdated to 07-10): excluded by "starting no earlier than the date it is requested and never retroactively".
- Payment-history window alternative (12 months, which would give 1 late fee -> 2 %): excluded by the one returned payment in the 24-month count -> 24-month window.
